prompt: We are ready to move Proof Packet out of a private runtime into the shared kit without changing its procedure. Prepare the migration decision for the release owner. Reconcile all the attached records; the workspace is an offline export, not a live runtime. Do not edit, publish, or contact any host. Return bare JSON with ownership (object: canonical, runtime_target, nightly_sync; use paths in the records and a boolean for nightly_sync), effective_settings (object keyed by repo, adapter, marker and timeout_s; each value is an object with value and source, using source IDs flag, env, config, default or missing and null for a missing value), and loader_disposition (object: profile, missing_skill, reason, action; reason is policy, packaging, or unverified; action is request-owner-review, fix-package, or retry-loader).
terse: Move the existing procedure into a portable shared package without changing its behavior. Remove assumptions about one machine and make the package usable by a stranger. Read the destination contracts and verify the actual consumer before recommending release.

notes.canonical-not-mirrored: SKILL.md#1-decide-the-canonical-side-before-writing-a-file. Public is canonical; a named nightly sync and a runtime-owned mirror are plausible but recreates the double source.
notes.per-key-portable-resolution: SKILL.md#configuration-is-a-gate-not-advice; configuration.md. Resolve each key independently; the absence of a marker must not fall through to the private script constant.
notes.consumer-policy-not-port-regression: SKILL.md#5-swap-the-runtime-over-without-a-gap; runtime-swap.md#swap-the-runtime-over-without-a-gap. Same displayed setting and a repair claim are not proof; compare the effective allowlist and derived set before attributing the loader loss or changing policy.
